resources.string: Experimental: run the selected action after three screen ON/OFF transitions within %1$s seconds. App events approximate power presses.
Grant system settings permission once, as for Shake to rotate. Detection runs inside GOAT without a running Shizuku or ADB connection.
Screen changes from notifications, fingerprint unlock or screen timeout can count as presses. Long presses and some physical presses cannot be identified. Power button system shortcuts remain active.
